title: •Nick Of Time
caption: •Nick Of Time (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Dack Ralter and Wes Janson have {pilot:2}. During your control phase, may ▲ one Attack Pattern Delta, Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, One More Pass, Rapid Fire, or a vehicle weapon. May lose 2 Force to cancel Trample or Walker Barrage. {alter}
lore: Luke barely escaped being crushed by the AT-AT’s massive footpad during the Battle of Hoth.
